Hi Jenna — thanks for the questions. Quick answers below and next steps: 

1) SOC 2 scope: Our SOC 2 Type II report (PDF attached) covers our hosted API and control environment for service delivery (security, availability, confidentiality). The report covers the period 2024-11-01 through 2025-10-31 and was issued 2025-11-10 by an independent auditor.

2) Bridge letter: We have provided a bridge letter that summarizes any relevant changes after the report period. There are no control exceptions; the bridge letter notes infrastructure upgrades and expanded monitoring coverage. Bridge letter attached: soc2_bridge_letter_2026-03-01.pdf

3) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA compliance for customers on Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted customers, we evaluate BAA requests on a case-by-case basis; we can start the BAA intake but some controls require Dedicated/Private architectures (e.g., customer-managed keys, isolated tenancy). If FinCo expects PHI in scope, let's flag that immediately so we can align the appropriate deployment and legal terms.

4) Technical details you asked for:
   - Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest for customer data in hosted environments.
   - Key management: Hosted customers use provider-managed KMS by default; Dedicated/Private customers can bring their own KMS/HSM.
   - Incident response: We maintain a documented IR plan with <72-hour notification for confirmed incidents affecting customer data; details available in portal evidence.
   - Subprocessors: Subprocessor list is in the Trust Portal (and we'll include a CSV export).
   - Data retention: Default retention policies and options are documented in the DPA; retention is configurable for Dedicated/Private customers.

Access & logistics:
- I've uploaded the SOC 2 PDF and bridge letter to the Trust Portal and created a FinCo access request link: https://trust.redwoodinference.com/finco/access-request/abc123
- Portal access will expire in 90 days by default; if you need longer, let me know and we can extend.
- If you'd like us to complete your questionnaire, please forward it (or grant us edit access to the attached spreadsheet). We'll prioritize the encryption, key management, incident response, subprocessor, and retention sections.

Attachments: soc2_typeII_redwood_2025.pdf, soc2_bridge_letter_2026-03-01.pdf

If helpful, I'm available for a short call with your security team to walk through the control mappings this week.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
